scenario: U.S. citizen living in California; reports rental activity, savings interest and Kalshi event-contract trading but no wages; household and tax facts unknown.
core_answer: No earned-income-only gate exists for MAGI Medi-Cal or Covered California. A $580 monthly MAGI-based household income route can meet community engagement for covered adults starting January 2027. Whether this person meets it is unknown. Six-month averaging under California's enacted statute applies to seasonal workers, not investment income merely because it fluctuates.

pathways.title: MAGI-based monthly income route
pathways.how: Show at least $580 of total monthly income calculated with MAGI-based methods for the applicable household. At application the assessment looks to the preceding month; at redetermination, any month since the previous determination. Actual countable amount is unknown.

pathways.title: Qualifying work (including documented property-management work if accepted)
pathways.how: Federal law provides an 80-hours-per-month work route. Landlord status alone does not establish 80 hours, Schedule C status or which activities qualify. Log actual work and seek county verification.
pathways.status: Verified general route; qualification of this person's work flagged

pathways.title: Qualifying community service
pathways.how: 80 hours per month of qualifying community service, or combine eligible activities as allowed by federal law; document participation.
pathways.status: Verified statutory route, subject to county verification

pathways.title: Qualifying education
pathways.how: At least half-time enrollment in a qualifying educational program is a statutory route; check actual program and enrollment documentation. Do not assume a universal credit-hour conversion.
pathways.status: Verified general route, enrollment not established

pathways.title: Qualifying work program
pathways.how: Participation in a qualifying work program may satisfy an 80-hour-per-month route; confirm the program and verification requirements with the county.
pathways.status: Verified general route, participation not established

pathways.title: Statutory exception from community engagement
pathways.how: Some individuals are excepted because of age, qualifying medical condition, caregiver status, Medicare or another statutory category. No exception for this person is established. Exception from work does not alone prove exception from six-month financial checks.
pathways.status: Verified general categories, personal status flagged

pathways.title: Temporary hardship exception
pathways.how: A qualifying disaster, high-unemployment area, medical hardship or other statutory temporary circumstance may excuse the requirement. California implementation and county-specific eligibility are not confirmed for this person.
pathways.status: Verified rule; particular county and individual eligibility flagged

seasonal_averaging.rule: The previous six months may be averaged under California Welfare & Institutions Code §14005.69(e)(7) for seasonal workers; fluctuating trading results by themselves are insufficient to claim this method.

recommendation_for_user: Request a real county or marketplace determination; retain rental expense records, interest statements and trading records; do not assume Kalshi tax character, income threshold, work hours or an exception without facts and verification. Respond to any county notice promptly.
